summary: Verified GET /api/student/selection-announcements/pending BACKFILL fix for the CPM-MDJ/2026/000062 late-status race. Pytest 6 passed / 2 skipped (env-guarded). Frontend Playwright on 390px viewport: temp late-status student logs in -> Selection Result popup appears with title 'Pengumuman Hasil Seleksi Berkas' + CTA 'Lihat Hasil Seleksi'; passed detail shows 'Selamat! Anda dinyatakan LULUS...'; after Selesai + reload popup does NOT reappear. Real published campaign (1722585f-...) and real student CPM-MDJ/2026/000062 registration were NOT deleted or modified in identity; only real campaign's late_recipient_count metric was incremented by +1 as a natural side-effect of the UI-flow backfill (behaviour matches spec).

minor.issue: When multiple Published campaigns match (both category=all AND category-specific), the endpoint picks by max published_at only. If admin later publishes an 'all' campaign after a category-specific one, students in that specific category will be backfilled by the newer 'all' campaign instead of their category-specific one. Consider prioritising exact-category match over 'all' when both are Published.

action_items: (Optional) Add tie-break to prefer exact-category Published campaign over category='all' when both match a student in the backfill selection.
(Optional) Consider guarding late_recipient_count increment when the backfill was triggered by an automated/synthetic student (test noise). Not required — matches production semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: Backfill in GET pending uses `find_one_and_update` with the SELECTION_RESULT_STATUSES + is_announcement_published=false guard: this correctly makes the write idempotent under concurrent polls (30s interval on FE + reload). Verified via test_late_passed_gets_notif_and_flag_and_idempotent (2 sequential calls -> 1 notif).
Notification insert AFTER the atomic reg update is safe because the update itself claims the flag; a second concurrent call finds no matching reg and skips insert.
Campaign sort key is `published_at` DESC only. Category='all' vs exact-category ties break by time, not specificity — see minor issue.
Mongo `_id` is projected out everywhere in this endpoint response (registration, campaign, notification). Verified via API assertions.

Frontend StudentDashboard polls both notifications and selection-announcements pending every 30s, ensuring late-status flips within an active session pick up the backfill without re-login. Verified indirectly via UI reload test.
server.py still 5585 lines — modularisation still pending (carry-over from iter33).
test_credentials: Real demo accounts unchanged. Temp students created via direct mongo insert with test_tag=TEST_iter34_backfill and TEST_iter34_ui; all removed on fixture teardown and manual cleanup after UI test.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test-tagged users + registrations + campaigns (far-future published_at 2099-01-01 to win sort). Real campaign 1722585f-6260-4aa5-a959-da1d30fe0143 was not deleted; its late_recipient_count metric increased by 1 as a natural consequence of one UI-flow backfill (test student, then removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `pytest backend/tests/test_selection_announcement_backfill.py -o addopts='' -v`. Env vars from /app/backend/.env and /app/frontend/.env must be exported. Invariants: (a) late-status student with unpublished flag + matching Published campaign -> exactly 1 selection_result notif per user, (b) idempotent under repeated GETs, (c) POST /seen -> pending null, (d) category-specific campaign never backfills a different-category student, (e) is_announcement_published=true short-circuits backfill, (f) non-final status short-circuits backfill. Note: real Published 'all' campaign 1722585f-... exists (2026-09-15) and will always be a fallback backfill source for any final-status student in this env; tests use far-future published_at (2099) to override sort when needed.
rca of the issue: Original bug (CPM-MDJ/2026/000062): campaign Published at 04:24Z but student's status transitioned to lolos_administrasi at 04:28Z, so the initial broadcast recipient scan (which snapshots users at publish time) excluded them; is_announcement_published was never set and no notification was created. Fix (verified): GET /student/selection-announcements/pending performs an idempotent claim-and-notify against any Published campaign matching the student's category (or 'all'), backfilling a single selection_result notification the next time the student polls. FE polls every 30s + on reload/login, so the popup surfaces autonomously. Mitigation quality: solid + idempotent + category-scoped; residual edge case only around 'all' vs exact-category tie-break (see minor issue).
